title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E5 — Inside Martha's Vegetable Greenhouse; Seed Starting
Martha takes us inside her vegetable greenhouse to see how she has turned her harvest into a year-round bounty; she collects, stores, and sows seeds, and makes her perfect green drink.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E6 — The Incredible World of Orchids
Martha visits the incredible Orchid Show at the New York Botanical Garden; this year's show immerses you in a mesmerizing array of orchids designed by acclaimed artist Lily Kwong.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E9 — Martha and the Chocolate Factory
Martha visits Mast Market in Mt. Kisco, N.Y., and learns the art behind making their renowned chocolate; from roasting cacao, to stone grinding, to forming delicious bars and chips.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E2 — India: A Tour of Food
Martha's friend and restaurateur, Shiva Natarajan, shares the key to making any Indian dish - spices; back in Martha's kitchen, they make butter chicken, lemon rice, and a tangy yogurt sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E4 — Picture Perfect Rolled Lasagna
Restaurant owners Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli join Martha in making their rolled lasagna with San Marzano tomato sauce, Italian bolognese, and chrysanthemum Caesar salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E5 — Easy Homemade Dumplings
Martha, Monica Tran Carden, and Andrew Yu make homemade dumplings; Martha and Monica hand-make wontons and pork dumplings; Andrew and Martha prepare jade dumplings and pork and shrimp dumplings.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E7 — Martha's Favorite Cakes
Martha makes the classic meringue cake from Casa Cipriani with pastry chef Alessia Tomassetti; Martha and bakery owner Lucie Franc De Ferriere bake a pear raspberry cake with jam and maple buttercream.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S3 E5 — Scented Geraniums; Guacamole; Brush Cleaner; Glycerin Leaves
Scented geraniums; guacamole; brush cleaner; glycerin leaves.

Fall foliage in New York City; ivy; furniture restoration.

title: Martha Stewart Living

Wooden furniture care; roasted garlic; ginger pumpkin pudding cake.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:

French fries; pan-fried chicken; Japanese tempura vegetables with dipping sauces.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E13 — Pan Searing
Pan-seared scallops with lemon-caper sauce; crisp-skinned salmon filet; pan-seared steak with mustard-cream sauce; Muscovy duck breasts with port wine reduction.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Roast
Rib roast; crown roast of pork; stuffed turkey breast; the best cuts for roasting.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E2 — Stewing
The basic elements of making a stew; beef stew; veal stew; coq au vin.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School

Homemade chicken soup; minestrone; velouté.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E2 — Growing Citrus
Martha explores the incredible world of citrus from yuzus and kumquats to citrons and mandarins; Martha visits Flavors by Bhumi in her home state of New Jersey to learn all about growing citrus.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E3 — Getting the Garden Going
Martha prepares her garden for the season's splendor - from planting hellebores to propagating trees to proper lawn care; plus, succulent pots for early color.
